name: Whirlpool
description: A whirlpool of particles circling a centre, turning faster as they spiral inward, with short trails.

props.name: particleCount
props.description: Number of particles in the whirl.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours from the rim inward; particles shift through them as they near the centre. By day they are drawn as ink, at night as light. The last colour also tints the core glow at night.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the turning and the inward drift. At 1 a particle takes about half a minute to reach the eye.

props.name: trail
props.description: How much of each frame is kept, from 0 (no trails) to 1 (long trails).

props.name: clockwise
props.description: Turn clockwise. False turns the other way.

props.name: center
props.description: The centre of the whirl, as fractions of the width and height.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the whirl. Other div props are passed through.
